title: 1995 AMC 8 Problem 14
statement: A team won \(40\) of its first \(50\) games. How many of the remaining \(40\) games must this team win so it will have won exactly \(70\%\) of its games for the season?

solutions.text:
The season has \(50 + 40 = 90\) games, and \(70\%\) of \(90\) is \(63\) wins.

The team already has \(40\) wins, so it needs \(63 - 40 = 23\) more.

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: The season has \(50 + 40 = 90\) games; find \(70\%\) of that
Subtract the \(40\) games already won from the needed total
